status: dev-only discovery; no promoted strategy or unseen inspection
authorization: 2026-10-02 user requests many thesis-connected PM/RTH basket and management runs, path understanding, and recovery of earlier 30-40 percent containment evidence
dev_days: calendar.evidence keys only; exclude 2024-*, 2025-01-*, 2026-06..08; do not substitute a recent-only sample
valid_cells: exit_et > entry_et and exit_et <= calendar session_end; additionally report calendar session_end as secondary forced-flat endpoint
ranking: US PIT listed common-stock universe, same universe at PM/RTH clocks, gain versus immediately previous trading session RTH close. No price/volume/mcap/gain/freshness floor. Last completed bar et<=clock-1; missing anchor unrankable and counted. Ascending ticker deterministic ties. Do not use future winners, Atlas roster or B(T) gain-from-open as admission.
corporate_actions: Do not claim actual gain ranking from a reverse-split-contaminated RAW prior-close ratio. Resolve a causal same-day reference-price normalization from provider evidence; record raw and normalized rank fields and action provenance. Future common rescaling factors may cancel in a ratio but may never affect eligibility. If normalization cannot be established, label RAW ranking explicitly and publish action-uncertain sensitivity, not pretend TV-equivalence.
allocation: capital=1 per independent basket day/entry clock; 3 fixed original slots each allocated 1/3 including entry fee. Equal initial dollars, shares fixed until exit. No rebalancing, replacement, adding, borrowing or reinvestment of released cash.
execution: decision at clock based on completed bars; buy first observed bar open with et>=entry_clock, no same-bar close fill. For fixed-clock sell, first observed bar open et>=exit_clock. Voluntary rule fired on bar et becomes known et+1; sell first observed open at or after et+1. Entry not filled before endpoint remains known cash; held position with missing liquidation is UNKNOWN, never zero or cash. No invented bars or prints; record actual fill and exit ET, delays, session and censoring. Do not call next printed open proven NBBO sellability.

management.run_order: unmanaged basket economics first, then named simple rule families; retain full grid including failures
management.note_amended_2026_10_02: re-entry, rotation, partials and reserve scale-in are explicitly authorized handling variants (owner directive); the frozen numbers live in each lane's _config.json / _grid.json written at run time
management.controls: same entry/end clocks, costs, supported prices; hold, cash and matched-time/exit-count member-release placebo to distinguish member information from merely less exposure
management.prior_art: Old R2 damage+wait and E1 fitted exhaustion are closed formulations, not novel candidates; their benchmarks do not reopen them. No model, threshold optimization, score fitting or rescue slices.

schemas.snapshots: per-day broad price-asof records + coverage manifest sufficient to reproduce top3; producer chooses compact layout and documents schema
schemas.storage: output_root/base/{snapshots,selected,bars}/YYYY-MM-DD.parquet with manifest per day and atomic ready markers. Preserve per-day resume, contract and source hashes. Write full aggregate selected.parquet/bars.parquet only if memory-safe; consumers must support per-day inputs.

path_anatomy: basket and each original member by wall clock and elapsed ET since actual fill; damage, recoveries, high cadence, volume/print decay; future MFE and winner/failure classes audit-only. Existing Atlas peer percentile is not market-wide rank. Print silence is not a certified halt. Member paths must be rebuilt for new selected tickers.
containment: Recover earlier 30-40 percent artifact and denominator; separately measure eventual session-max #1 membership, any eventual session-max top3 membership, terminal top3, joint multiple winners and remaining post-fill accessible move. Containment is not net profitability.
reporting: basket-day original-capital net means/medians, monthly and two chronological dev blocks; gross vs 100/150 bps; unknown counts and fill delays, member dollar attribution, time exposed, all untrimmed tails, top5-day-removed sensitivity not primary. Management delta = avoided fixed-endpoint losses minus foregone fixed-endpoint gains, not an optimal future-exit target. No inference from overlapping state count as independent trades.
operations: one network acquisition owner, max4 concurrent low-memory HTTP workers only after measuring canary RSS; max2GiB acquisition working memory target; economic/anatomy consumers per-day incremental max2GiB each. No signals/kills. Store new active output on Linux workspace filesystem if Windows volume approaches 15GiB free. Existing market rows remain gitignored, evidence aggregates and producer scripts committed.
